final: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost <> 0 THEN ili.derived_total_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_product_cost END) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number LIMIT 10
